source: User 1018.param (PX4 v1.17.0, MicoAir743v2-AIO), sha256 2d46b0bac6719cbbafc918b6f2cdcd5e86e83b50b4b922d426b3fa77668609c4, supplied 2026-10-21. MC_AT_EN/APPLY=1: gains may come from autotune.
status: Model of PX4 MulticopterRateControl + pseudo-inverse allocation with PX4 roll/pitch/yaw normalization and sequential desaturation (airmode off), from memory of the PX4 source, not line-verified against v1.17. Normalized motor output maps linearly to thrust (THR_MDL_FAC=0). Rate loop at 1 kHz versus about 666 Hz on the vehicle.
hover_throttle_source: 2026_10_18_px4.ulg hover_thrust_estimate median while airborne (THR_MDL_FAC=0, linear): normalized motor output o gives o * (m g / 4) / hover_throttle newtons, capped by the plant rotor limit. With the Ver2 inertia this reproduces a roll rise time of about 0.13 s against MC_AT_RISE_TIME 0.14 s.
